title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libxml2 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in the libxml2 library used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.8. These include denial of service via use-after-free, arbitrary code execution through various buffer overflows, data integrity issues from integer overflow, information disclosure, SSRF, and double-free/use-after-free in Python bindings. The update addresses these issues with security patches and bug fixes.
